issues.t: ECR publishes real-AWS registry hostnames instead of the emulator's own endpoint in repositoryUri and proxyEndpoint
ECR DescribeRepositories and DescribeImages reads diverge in ordering, continuation window and MaxResults/RepositoryNames validation
ecr: a CloudFormation AWS::ECR::Repository that declares a LifecyclePolicy stores no lifecycle policy — GetLifecyclePolicy and StartLifecyclePolicyPreview answer LifecyclePolicyNotFoundException
ECR validation and not-found error messages diverge from AWS wording
ECR repository and registry policy documents are neither validated nor normalized
ECR pull-through cache rule upstream-registry validation and storage diverge
ECR cross-account registry reads answer InvalidParameterException instead of AccessDeniedException
ECR: a pull-through cache rule never mirrors upstream — BatchGetImage on the cached repository is refused RepositoryNotFoundException instead of importing the image (1 cause)

ECR control-plane representation diverges: DescribeRepositories deduplicates repeated names, CreateRepository(KMS) never resolves the default managed key, CreatePullThroughCacheRule invents upstreamRegistry, and signing
ECR refusal messages are emulator-authored instead of the text ECR returns
ECR image-scan status surface reports the wrong ScanStatus and an emulator-authored status description
ECR: ValidatePullThroughCacheRule reports a registered rule as invalid, and registry-level scan-on-push never produces a scan (2 causes)
ECR refusal messages are the emulator's own prose, not AWS's wording, on six rejection paths (6 causes)

ECR GetDownloadUrlForLayer hands out an UNSIGNED download URL: the X-Amz-* query parameters are decorative, so a tampered 'presigned' URL is served 200 instead of refused 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch (1 cause)
ECR signing-on-push never records a signing status: DescribeImageSigningStatus stays empty for an image matched by a PutSigningConfiguration rule (1 cause)
ECR basic image scanning can never reach COMPLETE: every scan settles at FAILED/UnsupportedImageError, so scan findings are unreachable (1 cause)
ECR lifecycle-policy validation message drops the trailing newline AWS's validator emits inside the quoted failure text (1 cause)
ECR registry pull-time-update-exclusion list is capped at 1000 instead of 100, so RegisterPullTimeUpdateExclusion never returns LimitExceededException (1 cause)
ECR: image storage-class transitions, scan evaluation, media-type negotiation, replication status and error-message construction diverge (6 causes)
